summary: Extends Mobile IP so a device with several network interfaces, such as Wi-Fi and cellular, can register an address for each and keep multiple tunnels to its home agent at once. This allows the device to use all its interfaces together. It is an experimental specification.

eli5.summary: A phone with Wi-Fi and cellular is like a person with two doors to the house. This lets it use both doors at the same time.

questions: how can a mobile node use multiple interfaces with mobile ip
what is flow binding in mobile ip
